offering_description.value: Provides outsourced payroll, human resources, benefits administration, and workers’ compensation services to small and midsize employers. It delivers these services through co-employment agreements and local teams, and recruits and supplies temporary workers to businesses.

primary_services.value: Payroll administration; human resources consulting; workers’ compensation and workplace risk management; employee benefits administration; temporary staffing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Small and midsize employers outsourcing workforce administration or hiring temporary workers

end_markets.value: Construction; manufacturing; transportation and warehousing; professional services; hospitality

revenue_model.value: service fees: Ongoing payroll, human resources, benefits administration, and workers’ compensation services under co-employment agreements; transaction or usage fees: Temporary worker hours billed to client employers
revenue_model.category: service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses client workforce data to administer employment functions and recruits temporary workers for client businesses

geography_served.value: US national: Serves employers across the United States, with a branch network concentrated in the West

specialization.value: related lines: Co-employment, payroll and HR administration, workplace risk management, employee benefits, and temporary staffing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Local business development teams sell directly to employers; agents / brokers: Insurance brokers refer employers seeking outsourced workforce administration

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State licensing or registration for professional employer organizations, state workers’ compensation requirements, and federal and state payroll tax rules
